messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v4.1.0 -> 12% (regions: global, scope default). Initiator: leah. Command: `/deploy start --version v4.1.0 --percent 12 --note "embedding quality + perf"`

leah: Kicking off canary. Preflight OK. Change window 00:30-04:30 UTC. I'll watch embedding-quality signals and user-facing ranking regression alerts.

marco: ML team smoke passed. New embedding head increases recall in internal evals but there's a small distribution shift vs v4.0.8 for some short queries. Watching similarity metrics.

ai-eval-bot: EVAL: embedding-cosine-drop small cohort (short queries) -> mean delta -0.04 (threshold -0.02) for sample cohort "news-headlines". See dashboard: https://evals.redwood/emb/v4.1.0/vs-v4.0.8

claire: @marco that cohort corresponds to our search suggestion flow. If similarity drops we can see wrong suggestions for end-users. Recommend pausing further percent bumps until we confirm.

ops-sre: Vote: HOLD until ML triage. Pin the rollout to prevent accidental bump. Rollback criteria (summary): significant quality regression in core evals OR sustained downstream error surge (5xx > 0.5% for 3m). Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --version v4.0.8 --percent 100`. Also note routing fallback option: route embedding requests to variant v4.0.8-emb for 100% of embedding calls in affected region.

leah: Proposing two mitigation paths: (A) targeted routing fallback for embeddings while we iterate (low blast radius), (B) full rollback if routing doesn't restore QA quickly. Which is faster to execute?

marco: Routing fallback is fast. We can flip a routing policy for embeddings in ~2m: `/routing set --service embeddings --priority v4.0.8-emb --percent 100 --scope global` That will divert embedding calls but keep other ML endpoints on v4.1.0. We'll run the evaluation harness post-flip to confirm recovery.

ai-eval-bot: NOTE: hooking to run dev-eval harness after any routing change. Also running A/B live quality probe for top-queries.

leah: Ok let's pin and run fallback first. Pin recorded and bumps disabled until further notice. Also draft a short support blurb in case users notice degraded suggestions.

deploy-bot: Action: `/release pin v4.1.0 --scope all --reason "embedding quality regression in short-query cohort" --initiator leah` recorded. Thread state: PAUSED (pinned).

support: Draft blurb: "We're investigating a regression affecting some search suggestions after a platform update; engineers are triaging and a limited mitigation is in progress." Short and shareable to #support.

marco: Executing routing fallback for embeddings now (target: global) to v4.0.8-emb. Command: `/routing set --service embeddings --priority v4.0.8-emb --percent 100`

deploy-bot: Routing change recorded. New routing rules applied to embeddings -> v4.0.8-emb (100%). Note: routing changes take ~30s to propagate across edge caches.

ai-eval-bot: EVAL POST-FALLBACK: news-headlines cohort cosine delta now -0.005 (within threshold). Live A/B probe shows suggestion mismatch rate reduced to baseline. Full eval report: https://evals.redwood/emb/post-fallback/4356789012

claire: That's promising. If metrics remain stable for 10-15m we can unpin and continue staged rollout but keep embeddings pinned to old variant until ML signs off on model tuning.

ops-sre: Recommendation: maintain rollout pin for control-plane version (v4.1.0) but keep targeted routing fallback for embeddings. Documenting rollback contingency: if fallback does not stabilize quality within 15m, escalate to full rollback.

leah: Agreed. I'll set a 15m re-eval timer and own the postmortem if we need rollback. Also adding a note to release notes: "Embedding routing fallback applied for short-query cohort; working with ML on tuning."

deploy-bot: Recorded: routing-fallback applied; rollout pinned. To resume percent bumps after sign-off: `/deploy resume --version v4.1.0` (requires release-manager approval).

ops-sre: Also adding an action item: run a canary that exercises short-query traffic mix specifically before any future bump beyond 25%.

marco: ML will run a longer eval sweep and submit PR for adjusted training mix. ETA 2-4 hours. If all green we can plan a controlled unpin of embeddings and continue.

ai-eval-bot: NOTE: scheduled background evals for next 2h. Will post results in this thread.

leah: Thanks everyone. Re-eval in 15m or earlier if alerts change. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
